title: tetranthera angulata
intro: Tetranthera angulata, commonly known as the Angle-Leaf Tetranthera, is a plant species belonging to the family Annonaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tetranthera angulata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe a sore throat and relieve congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
